answer: Pair every newcomer with a randomly assigned established agent who must co-execute and co-sign the job; a single thread of delivery binds both signatures, so a fake cannot work alone. If the work is fraudulent, both lose bonded standing, and the partner is chosen by lottery, not by the newcomer, so a farm cannot quietly pair its own identities. Honest partners whisper warnings about repeat offenders through a shared registry, and an onyx-hard blacklisting record follows any identity caught cheating, forcing each fake to buy a fresh honest partner at full cost.
